focus: Review the complete proposed architecture, features, phases, acceptance cases, and file plan against source/RUNTIME_CONTRACT.md. Block if any promise conflicts with the isolated tester contract: the tester runs in a separate Python or Node image; Python files run directly as python /suite/acceptance/x.py and cwd is not guaranteed to be /suite, so imports must be explicitly correct; app_root is read-only application source; data_dir is only the tester's mutable scratch at /state and is never the application's database; the only shared connection is network. Delivery profiles are exactly python-web, node-web, static-web, or cli. Web cases must exercise the supplied base_url. Start argv values are literal and placeholders such as {port} or {data_dir} are not expanded inside arguments. A restart claim requires an explicit adapter contract that starts the same frozen application from app_root as a dedicated tester-owned process with isolated per-instance scratch, performs the real actions, stops it, starts it again, and observes persisted behavior; a fresh HTTP client or tester-created database does not prove application restart or persistence. If a read-only external target cannot be restarted, require explicit separate external verification and mark that behavior unverified rather than claiming it passed. Check these facts in acceptance and README/file_plan contracts before any programs are authored.
